text:
zoe: Quick RFC follow-up re: v2 typed-predicate policy surface. Two asks: backcompat and safe rollout before runtime change window.

matt: Proposed approach: conversion at upload (control plane) -> runtime only evaluates typed predicates. Keeps runtime simpler.

lia: Must preserve provenance: keep original clause text linked to compiled artifact for explainability.

nina: Conversion should auto-handle simple patterns (eq, range, membership). Regex/JS transforms need guidance or manual change.

raju: Tool should emit annotated AST: converted + unconverted nodes. If partial, either reject or require tenant compatibility opt-in.

ops-bot: deploy: policy-service-staging v0.84. feature.policy_shim=false.

zoe: Minimal migration checklist: 1) conversion CLI + linter, 2) compile shim that stores compiled_ir + original_text + source_version, 3) per-tenant compatibility flag (default off), 4) telemetry metrics (conv_success/partial/error), 5) console diffs + 90-day deprecation.

matt: Add tests: property-based equivalence checks and e2e regression gates. Store artifacts in blob store with TTL aligned to deprecation.

lia: Governance: tenant admin approval to enable compatibility. Show diffs in console before opt-in.

nina: Rollout sketch: staging behind flag -> beta tenants opt-in -> auto-convert safe policies -> reject new v1 uploads after 90 days. Keep compatibility runtime only for limited window (3-6 months) and emergency escape-hatch gated by ops.

zoe: Action items: @matt proto PR, @raju conversion CLI sketch, @lia console diff mock, @nina tenant comms. I'll write RFC addendum with timeline.
